programme.desc: 西拉沐淪河發源於內蒙古高原的渾善達克沙地腹地，在赤峰境內奔流407千米後，匯入西遼河，最終注入渤海，是中國北方重要的河流之一西拉沐淪河流域作為內蒙古東部重要的水源涵養地，維持著周邊草原沙地濕地的生態平衡同時，流域內棲息著多種候鳥（如丹頂鶴白枕鶴）魚類（如瓦氏雅羅魚）及珍稀植物，是東亞澳大利西亞候鳥遷徙通道的重要組成部分，蜿蜒流淌的高原長河，孕育著豐富的野生動物種群和多樣的植被類型，使西拉沐淪河流域成為了中國北方的生物基因庫由中央廣播電視總台推出的西拉沐淪是中國首部北疆河流生態科學紀錄片全片共 4集，每集25分鐘深入內蒙古高原渾善達克沙地腹地，透過地質動物植物與環境依存關係，全方位展現西拉沐淪河流域（赤峰一帶）的壯麗自然景觀與豐富物種本節目由ampampampamplt赤峰市融媒體中心ampampampampgt贈播

programme.title: 鯤鵬擊浪
programme.desc: 該劇由劉飚執導，劉承林米卓清領銜主演，講述1918年毛澤東從湖南第一師範畢業到1921年參加黨的一大所歷經的心路歷程這期間中國發生了巨大的變化，新文化運動掀起西學東漸的風潮，馬克思主義的曙光第一次照進中國，五四運動高舉起自由與民主的旗幟，軍閥混戰的硝煙加重了中國人民的苦難在這風雲際會的歷史舞台上，各方勢力風起雲湧，詭異的時局迷霧重重，國家和民族的命運如同蕭瑟寒風中的一葉扁舟，生死存亡只在一瞬這幾年間，毛澤東在國家民族危難之際，胸懷大志堅韌不拔尋找救國救民道路，從一個青年學子逐漸成長為堅定的馬克思主義者該劇通過毛澤東北上尋求真理組織青年學生赴法勤工儉學領導湖南驅張運動創辦湘江評論開展學運工運組建湖南共產主義小組等事件，記述了毛澤東如何在紛繁雜亂的眾多主義中尋找到馬克思主義並為之奮鬥一生的感人故事

programme.title: 금수미앙
programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.desc: 너에게 닿기를은 2005년부터 연재되기 시작한 소녀만화이다. 애니메이션은 2009년 10월부터 2010년 3월까지 일본 현지에서 방영되었으며, 그 인기에 힘입어 게임소프트가 제작되기도 하였다. 단행본 전10권은 1000만부가 넘게 팔릴 정도의 인기 작이며 2010년 6월 현재, 11권이 발행되었다.

programme.title: 네모바지 스폰지밥
programme.desc: 어린이들 사이에서 최고의 인기를 자랑하고 있는 바닷속 네모난 친구는 누구일까요? 기상천외하고 유쾌하면서도 매력만점의 주인공 스폰지밥을 만나보세요! 저 깊은 태평양 바닷속, 비키니 씨티라는 해저도시에는 네모낳고 노란 해면동물 스폰지밥과 친구들이 있습니다. 스폰지밥은 애완동물인 달팽이 핑핑이와 함께 파인애플 집에 살고 있습니다. 스폰지밥의 장기는 정말 맛있는 음식을 척척 만들어 내는 멋쟁이 요리사라는 점과 언제나 모든 소동과 사건의 현장에 있다는 것입니다! 괴팍한 이웃 친구 징징이를 괴롭히는 것도 스폰지밥의 또다른 특기죠. 스폰지밥의 단짝 친구는 솔직하고 사랑스러운 불가사리 뚱이, 그리고 스릴만점의 모험을 즐기는 여자친구인 다람이입니다. 꿈과 환상의 도시인 비키니 시티 에서는 물고기 친구들이 걸어다니고, 게살버거가 가장 맛있는 음식은 이라고 하네요. 지금 바로 바닷속에 뛰어들어서 스폰지밥의 매력에 흠뻑 젖어보세요!

programme.title: 신비아파트:고스트볼의 비밀
programme.desc: 귀신이 나오는 장소로 유명한 신비아파트, 그것도 444호에 이사 오게 된 하리네 가족. 첫날부터 그들은 자꾸만 이상한 일들에 휩싸이게 된다. 아무도 안 산다는 위층에선 밤새 쿵쿵거리는 소리가 울리고, 아파트 맨홀에서 기어 나온 괴상한 꼬마 아이는 자꾸만 내기를 하자며 하리에게 덤벼든다. 그러다 얼떨결에 꼬마 아이가 입에 달고 다니는 엿을 빼앗아 먹게 된 하리와 동생 두리. 그 이후부터 그들의 눈엔 하나둘 무서운 귀신의 모습이 보이기 시작하고, 정체를 알 수 없는 맨홀 꼬마는 귀신을 없애주면 원하는 소원은 뭐든지 이루어주겠다며 큰소리치는데...

programme.title: 錦衣之下
programme.desc: 天賦異稟的六扇門女捕快袁今夏因為一樁案件和性情狠辣的錦衣衛陸繹結下樑子，今夏本以為此生與他再無交集，奈何冤家路窄朝廷十萬兩修河款不翼而飛，今夏奉命協助陸繹一起下揚州查案，替朝廷找回丟失的官銀本是道不同不相為謀，卻因驚天密案聯手兩人從勢同水火到刮目相看再到情難自已，命運的齒輪從此旋轉在一起然而事與願違，今夏竟是當年夏然案的遺孤，背負家族血仇的她與陸繹之間橫生了無法跨越的鴻溝最後，兩個有情人歷經苦難，為救百姓抗倭寇除奸佞，放下家族仇怨，聯手對敵，衝破世俗枷鎖，勇敢地走到了一起

programme.desc: 精打細算的戀愛，郭書瑤vs林子閎金錢價值觀保衛戰，有錢沒錢都要愛！！不追求戀愛的節儉會計師上班族簡可可，平易近人做事俐落個性率直又善良碰上了花錢如流水的同事王海闊，是能力強業界有名的王牌業務對彼此逐漸動心的愛情，兩人的金錢價值觀卻大大不同，要如何在愛情與麵包做選擇呢?

programme.title: 明月照我心
programme.desc: 白天冷戰晚上同床？失憶王爺方逸倫遇上催眠公主凌美仕！！互看不順眼的汐月公主李明月與北宣資王李謙，因政治和親被迫成為夫妻意外的是，李明月施展的催眠術，竟喚醒李謙遺失已久的記憶線索，患有夢遊症的他，總是會在李明月的床上醒來為找回失去的過往，李謙勉強接受這段婚姻，卻在朝夕相處中，從排斥防備，到逐漸動心當真相與感情交錯，這對歡喜冤家也將攜手揭開隱藏已久的秘密

programme.title: 青春女生宿舍新
programme.desc: 多名大學女生一起住在宿舍中，她們不僅個性迥異，各自的人生目標和喜歡的男生類型也大相逕庭 觀賞預告並進一步了解

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗前夫陸雲旗方家獨子方承宇，身份各異關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 青面修羅
programme.desc: 因一塊藏寶銅片慘遭滅門的青面修羅齊君元，在神秘刺客組織離恨谷長大某日離恨谷受託奪取藏寶銅片，谷主卻未派齊君元追查，但齊君元決意復仇，不惜叛谷暗自出馬調查血案消失多年的銅片為何再現？面對各路高手追殺捲入兩國鬥爭，齊君元發現自己已身陷局中，設局者是何方神聖？神秘委託人又是何許人也？

programme.title: 掃毒3：人在天涯
programme.desc: 國際販毒集團毒梟康素差一直帶著手下張建行等人從事毒品交易，新加入集團的成員歐志遠也因一次意外，與兩人建立了過命交情，三人情同手足康素差在香港的販毒生意突然被警方查獲，他帶著團隊逃到金三角發展，積極籠絡當地的土皇帝戴金榮，計劃兩人聯手擴大勢力，讓自己東山再起，卻意外發現身邊藏有臥底此刻，是敵是友，一片茫然

programme.title: 秦時明月52-54完首
programme.desc: 秦時明月52-54完首

programme.title: 賞金獵人
programme.desc: 李山來歷不明，但擁有超強武打能力阿YO智慧過人，曾任國際刑警機緣巧合下，才貌兼備的Cat天才駭客Swan和力量超凡的Bobo也加入了他們的公司一天他們接到任務，眾人兵分兩路查探懷疑藏有炸彈的濟州島A酒店他們目標是揪出近期在A酒店發生的連環爆炸案的始作俑者

programme.title: 通天神探狄仁傑
programme.desc: 武則天登基前正在興建高達百米的通天浮屠，此時發生接二連三的駭人自焚案，且死者皆為朝廷權貴武后聽從國師指示，召回神探狄仁傑查案，命為欽差，並派上官靜兒裴東協助兼監視狄仁傑狄仁傑聽從舊日同僚沙陀建議，深入鬼市探查線索卻反遭追殺，隨著案情逐漸明朗，所有證據竟都直指武后本人

programme.title: 困獸
programme.desc: 為了有效降低社會犯罪率整頓已經紛亂不堪的地下博彩業，政府聯合警方和博彩協會，嚴密展開打擊地下賭場的行動，並將新建賭場經營權拍賣處理以肅清博彩業，但不為人知的利益和秘密，卻引發賭城風雲與各方人馬衝突

programme.title: 虎穴屠龍之轟天陷阱
programme.desc: 香港總督察林國正嫉惡如仇，制止黑幫犯罪活動無數，其妻蔡潔多年來一直為丈夫出生入死而擔憂，在多番勸告下，林亦顧及妻子和幼女敏的安全，便暫時答應妻子移民加拿大林雖不願移民但又要挽回家庭，唯有先請假到紐約，希望能説服妻子改變移民計劃，可惜在陰差陽錯之間，林巧遇仇家王子，在保護潔之餘，終於和王子展開火拼

programme.title: 限時救援
programme.desc: 在妹妹失蹤後，姐姐賢貞通過手機追查到妹妹失蹤前，曾出現在一個偏僻的小山村她向鄰近的派出所報告，卻被警察拒絕，賢貞只好自己追查線索根據目擊者提供的線索，賢貞得知妹妹曾在平坤家出現過，但是村民們都澄清平坤不會是犯人失望的賢貞正打算離開時，赫然發現驚人的線索，也讓賢貞的處境變得更加危險

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之西域雄獅
programme.desc: 清朝末年，黃飛鴻帶著十三姨徒弟鬼腳七前往美國舊金山視察牙擦蘇開設的寶芝林分館，途中卻遇上事故，黃飛鴻為救十三姨而不慎墜河，失去記憶，被當地的印地安人部落搭救當黃飛鴻恢復記憶與徒弟們會合後，卻被當地鎮長栽贓為搶劫銀行的劫匪黃飛鴻為還眾人清白，與真正劫匪對決

programme.title: 蘇乞兒之武功蓋世
programme.desc: 蘇燦出生於軍官家庭，自幼酷愛武術，進京趕武，卻遭禁毒陷害，家破人亡清朝末年，廣東十虎蘇乞兒決戰斧頭幫與江湖大盜，最後創立門派

programme.title: 唐門之神犼雙雄
programme.desc: 唐門門主過世，二十年前的事再次掀起江湖紛爭，各方勢力針鋒相對，中原質子唐離與唐門少主唐天行，少女唐心陷入風暴的中心，一場圍繞兩個少年身世的秘密逐漸浮現，在各大門派的追殺中，二十年的武林大戰再次發生

programme.title: 斷網
programme.desc: 駭客突然發動襲擊，幸好天才網路保安主任卓家俊利用研發的防火牆，化解危機孰不知這波攻擊竟是由其上司陳明志操控，他也因此誤入洗黑錢圈套，為證清白，他與陳明志展開網路攻防此時，卓家俊研發的病毒突然失控，瞬間全城斷網，引起莫大恐慌，後果不堪設想

programme.title: 新精武門
programme.desc: 精武門大師兄陳真離世後，精武門人慘遭迫害其師妹麗兒決心為他報仇雪恨，在探長的安排下，她渡海來到臺灣尋求外公的扶助，卻慘遭日本人追殺幸虧途中遇到阿龍援助得以逃脫，於是麗兒與外公決心培養阿龍作為陳真的接班人，教授其武功日本武士岡村欲統一全台灣武術界，歸入其大和門下，於是多次壓迫精武體育會，阿龍眼見中國人受此侮辱，決心學武在一次岡村召開的武術大會中，施展精武門絕技，將日本武士逐個擊敗，重振聲威

programme.title: 八星報喜
programme.desc: 一次電話線故障，促成方氏三兄弟的三段姻緣大哥方劍輝（黃百鳴飾）品性敦厚，與失婚婦人吳芬芳（馮寶寶飾）由冤家發展成戀人；天性風流的二哥方劍郎（周潤發飾）瞞著女友飄紅（鄭裕玲飾），與熱情如火的美麗（鍾楚紅飾）迅即擦出火花；三弟方劍笙（張學友飾）性格害羞，與在公園邂逅的開朗少女瑩瑩（袁潔瑩飾）萌芽出一段細水長流的純潔愛情三段姻緣來得意外，結局卻各有不同

programme.title: 本日公休
programme.desc: 阿蕊開了四十年的男士家庭理髮，面對生活的煩擾，阿蕊總是以台灣歐巴桑的精神面對人生有天阿蕊接到一通電話，搬到遠方的老客人生病無法出門剪頭髮，拜託阿蕊到府服務阿蕊想起師傅教她這一行要服務客人到底，於是掛上本日公休的牌子，她要出發去做一件所有人都認為不值得的事

programme.title: 武狀元蘇乞兒
programme.desc: 滿清年間，旗人子弟蘇察哈爾燦目不識丁揮霍成性為贏得丐幫美女如霜芳心，決定上京考武狀元蘇父買通考官由師爺代筆考中武狀元，但被臥底宮中之天理教教主趙無忌揭發舞弊皇帝怒將燦父子貶為乞丐流落街頭，燦又遭趙無忌打成殘廢後燦偶遇丐幫長老洪日慶授以睡夢羅漢拳，如霜被趙無忌擄走，燦以睡夢羅漢拳奪得幫主之位，率眾迎戰造反之趙無忌，終於領悟降龍十八掌

programme.title: 九品芝麻官
programme.desc: 包龍星買了一個縣令官職，他愛上的美女秦氏卻嫁給一位富商數月後，戚秦氏因絕世美貌遭水師提督常昆之子常威染指，戚家當晚慘遭滅門，首要凶嫌戚秦氏被刑求入獄待秋後處斬包龍星則被迫拔官，淪落至一妓院做龜公，因緣際會結識微服出遊之皇帝，被封為八府巡按後回鄉重審此案，號稱白面包青天，終將常威就地正法，戚秦氏沈冤得雪

programme.title: 星際特工瓦雷諾：千星之城
programme.desc: 盧貝松執導科幻作品瓦雷諾與蘿琳娜是時空旅行特務的精英成員，他們不斷在時間與空間中穿梭，維護28世紀的世界秩序兩位特工搭檔意外捲入巨大的星際陰謀，從而引發一場關乎7000多個宇宙種族存亡之戰

programme.title: 潛艦追緝
programme.desc: 被法國海軍封為地表最強千里耳的尚特雷，以超敏銳的聽覺讓海軍弟兄們免於無數次的潛艦危機在敘利亞海域的任務中，卻出現他此生從未聽過也無法分辨的聲軌，隨著聲音漸漸逼近，竟讓潛艦暴露了行蹤，引爆了深海危機；與此同時，法國與俄羅斯的國際情勢逐漸上漲，竟有一顆核彈朝向法國而來，即將成為引爆第三次世界大戰的導火線！

programme.title: 波伽利：聲命之歌
programme.desc: 阿莫斯生來就擁有美妙嗓音，卻因為先天性眼疾進入盲人學校，之後又在一場足球比賽意外後完全失明個性好強的他，卻從未因此放棄自己對音樂的熱情與夢想在恩師（安東尼奧班德拉斯飾）的嚴厲指導下，他的歌唱技巧不斷提升與突破，終於獲得義大利國寶級搖滾明星蘇奇洛賞識，親自邀他同台獻唱，此後開始朝史上最成功的跨界男高音之路邁進

programme.title: 美聲歌雞
programme.desc: 圖魯是一隻相貌古怪且不會下蛋的母雞，因此遭到其他母雞的嘲笑和排擠曾是音樂老師的老奶奶伊莎貝爾非常喜歡圖魯，她將圖魯帶到自己的農場，竟意外發現圖魯的獨特天賦她不僅能夠跟人類說話，還有著美麗的動人歌聲，但伊莎貝爾害怕其他人會利用圖魯的天賦賺錢，於是決定守住這個秘密某天，伊莎貝爾從屋頂上摔下來而且失去了記憶，隨後被救護車送往醫院；想念老奶奶的圖魯決定踏上旅程尋找她珍貴的好友！

programme.title: 即刻救援
programme.desc: 退休特務布萊恩在與赴歐洲旅遊的愛女小琴通越洋電話時，親耳聽到小琴慘遭人口販子綁架，最強老爸將憑藉特務經驗及施展過人身手，追擊人口販子並親自救回掌上明珠！

programme.title: 星光首映場毀滅倒數
programme.desc: 不久的未來，漂泊的太空人大衛，正在外太空進行例行氣候視察一場失控的意外，讓大衛與太空船及地球指揮中心失去聯繫而此時的地球，機器人與人工智慧已經成為人們生活的好夥伴；科技的快速發展，讓人們可以重返並編輯自己過去的記憶租借身體，甚至高階的人類，更可以選擇讓自己長生不老只是，當仰賴的科技變成真實夢魘，世界即將在十分鐘內毀滅，人們還能掌控自己想要的未來嗎？

programme.title: 殺手保鑣2
programme.desc: 億萬票房殺手保鑣系列續集，原班人馬霸氣回歸！首集的嗆辣老婆索妮亞保釋出獄後成為受保護的對象，為防止獨裁勢力摧毀整個歐洲，影史最強三賤客合體的嘴賤攻防，前所未見超乎想像！

programme.title: 倒數計死首
programme.desc: 奎茵是一位護士，她大膽下載了可以預測死期的APP，並驚訝得知僅剩三天壽命可活起初，奎茵以為這只是個無聊的惡作劇，沒想到身邊曾經下載的人，卻一個接著一個如APP所預測的時間接連死去，即使刪除檔案更換手機，都無法擺脫死亡倒數隨著死期逼近，她能否在時間結束前，挽救自己的生命呢？

programme.title: 醉後的浪漫首
programme.desc: 醉後的浪漫首

programme.title: 拳力一搏
programme.desc: 一個高利貸業者因傳統營業模式已逐漸式微，開始計畫調整自己的生活，然而當地警察仍緊迫盯人，而他自身的病痛也越來越嚴重最終他決定在退休的前一天，進行一件不可能的行動，若是成功，他就能擺脫最後的煩惱，埋葬黑暗的過去

programme.title: 攔截永生碼
programme.desc: 為了青春永駐，你願付出多少代價？跨時代發明的永生技術將思想轉移到新的身體上問世之後，開發者布里琪發現，其中一個原型有著重大的缺陷，準備要將研究成果下架，但家人陸續被綁架，她才意識到，自己已經踏入一場生死交關的非法交易

programme.title: 極地先鋒
programme.desc: 舉世聞名的極地探險家阿蒙森是史上首位征服南極的人，一舉揭開地圖上的空白領域，為人類文明展開史無前例的新頁，璀璨成就讓他留名千古不過作為一個男人，阿蒙森的故事卻不止於此，透過親弟弟利昂與妻子貝絲的不同視角，阿蒙森在冒險背後的爭議人生，也逐一揭曉

programme.title: 非法地帶
programme.desc: 為了紀念父親而登山的夏儂（傑米金飾演）無意間撞見當地警察的違法勾當，這些警察不僅介入毒品交易，甚至不惜殺人滅口夏儂將犯罪過程拍了下來，卻被當場發現，一場驚心動魄的追逐就此展開而身經百戰的資深警察傑克（布魯斯威利飾演）也恰巧捲入這場衝突，他將不惜一切代價聲張正義，將罪犯繩之以法

programme.title: 毀滅倒數
programme.desc: 不久的未來，漂泊的太空人大衛，正在外太空進行例行氣候視察一場失控的意外，讓大衛與太空船及地球指揮中心失去聯繫而此時的地球，機器人與人工智慧已經成為人們生活的好夥伴；科技的快速發展，讓人們可以重返並編輯自己過去的記憶租借身體，甚至高階的人類，更可以選擇讓自己長生不老只是，當仰賴的科技變成真實夢魘，世界即將在十分鐘內毀滅，人們還能掌控自己想要的未來嗎？

programme.title: 罪惡對決
programme.desc: 1970年代的愛爾蘭，芬巴墨菲在戰爭後隱居偏遠小鎮，為了擺脫過去，芬巴決心重拾對生活的熱情，同時一個愛爾蘭共和軍小組也來到小鎮藏身，當芬巴發現其同夥曾對當地女孩施暴後，便迫使他在金盆洗手前執行最後一次任務，隨著局勢愈加緊張，芬巴必須在暴露自己祕密身分和保護鎮民之間做出抉擇

programme.title: 湯恩與劍客汪汪隊
programme.desc: 湯恩希望追隨父親的腳步，成為皇家劍客汪汪隊一員他前往巴黎冒險，遇見喋喋不休的老鼠皮普，並成了湯恩的隨從湯恩與貼身戰友經歷無數場戰役，不僅要力抗邪惡的紅衣主教及其黨羽，還要阻止英法爆發戰爭歷經了這些後，湯恩發現友誼和正義的寶貴價值湯恩最終能成為劍客汪汪隊的一員並贏得佳人的芳心嗎？

programme.title: 可可農莊大冒險
programme.desc: 在單身父親陷入財務困境後，十二歲的麥克斯不得不關閉他在自家車庫裡經營的小買賣，隨父從城裡搬到了村裡，暫時寄住在他姑姑家 在這裡，滿腦子生意經的麥克斯發現了商機，和堂弟查理及當地小網紅愛麗絲一起將一間廢舊的倉庫改造成了養雞棚，養殖注重動物福利的快樂母雞，出售快樂雞蛋，可可農莊誕生了，而且生意興隆好景不長，三個年輕的企業家將面臨一個接一個的挑戰

programme.title: 神鬼獵殺
programme.desc: 世界知名富豪溫氏集團創始人尼里歐離奇墜海溺斃，他的死訊導致跨國經濟體系受到衝擊，更引起溫氏集團繼承人的明爭暗鬥沒有親人的尼里歐早在30年前就收養了一個小男孩羅格溫奇，秘密訓練他成為有勇有謀的精英，也是唯一的合法繼承人羅格溫奇在繼承前的第一個難題，就是洗清自己遭人誣陷入獄的冤屈

programme.title: 星光首映場倒數計死
programme.desc: 奎茵是一位護士，她大膽下載了可以預測死期的APP，並驚訝得知僅剩三天壽命可活起初，奎茵以為這只是個無聊的惡作劇，沒想到身邊曾經下載的人，卻一個接著一個如APP所預測的時間接連死去，即使刪除檔案更換手機，都無法擺脫死亡倒數隨著死期逼近，她能否在時間結束前，挽救自己的生命呢？

programme.title: 武狀元蘇乞兒
programme.desc: 滿清年間，旗人子弟蘇察哈爾燦目不識丁揮霍成性為贏得丐幫美女如霜芳心，決定上京考武狀元蘇父買通考官由師爺代筆考中武狀元，但被臥底宮中之天理教教主趙無忌揭發舞弊皇帝怒將燦父子貶為乞丐流落街頭，燦又遭趙無忌打成殘廢後燦偶遇丐幫長老洪日慶授以睡夢羅漢拳，如霜被趙無忌擄走，燦以睡夢羅漢拳奪得幫主之位，率眾迎戰造反之趙無忌，終於領悟降龍十八掌

programme.title: 血染雪山堡
programme.desc: 二戰中期盟軍重要人物－美國卡納比將軍，座機在德奧邊界墜毀被俘，就近被囚禁在阿爾卑斯山中地勢險惡的鷹堡英國軍情六處特納上校立即派遣以特工史密斯少校為首與美軍謝弗中尉等精通德語的七人突擊隊，假扮德軍深入敵營搶救但在空降時通訊士意外喪命，不久又有兩名成員離奇身亡，更離譜的是謝弗中尉從史密斯少校口中得知，卡納比將軍竟是由演員所扮演！這艱鉅的鷹堡搶救任務，究竟還隱藏著甚麼更大的陰謀？

programme.title: 報告班長3
programme.desc: 在一次突擊式的模擬軍事演習中，蘇班長率小穎等眾兵戍海岸線，準備殲滅登陸的藍軍，不料小穎誤觸引爆炸藥的按鈕，而將演習弄得一團亂，全連也因此被派赴基地再訓練負責訓練的屠班長暗下決定，一切要從頭開始烏龍班終於在營裡舉行成果驗收之日，展現最亮麗的一面，也在五項戰技測驗中為連長奪下一面獎牌

programme.title: 古董局中局
programme.desc: 來自日本的木戶加奈小姐即將歸還中國一尊唐代武則天時期的明堂佛頭，指明要文物界組織五脈旗下白字門許家後人出面接收有著一身鑒古天賦的許家後人許願，在黃煙煙勸說下，他不情願的前往交涉，卻敏銳地察覺到佛頭是贗品許願本想逃避，然而面對重重迷霧和威脅，已是身不由己他必須要在各方勢力的糾纏之下，查明真相

programme.title: 藍徽特攻隊
programme.desc: 一戰末期德軍在西部前線戰事吃緊，畢業於104飛行學校的史達赫中尉來到了威利上尉的飛行中隊當時飛行員最高榮譽是擊落敵機二十架可獲頒藍色徽章史達赫在首次任務就擊落英軍飛機一架，卻未得到陸軍證實而不算，但史達赫的戰功並未因此停滯不前；最終，史達赫榮獲最高榮譽，卻在授予藍色勳章那天，有人向元帥爆料史達赫紀錄不實的內幕，中隊長決定把他送至柏林軍事法庭究責

programme.title: 猛龍過江
programme.desc: 武功高強的唐龍，受朋友所託遠赴歐洲協助解決一家餐館的業權問題，遇上黑幫搗亂及威迫，並恥笑中國拳術，唐大怒出手把洋人打得抱頭鼠竄，黑幫首領大為震怒，最後請來美國國際空手道冠軍，與唐龍決一死戰

programme.title: 河神：詭水怪談
programme.desc: 故事講述了天津衛五河撈屍隊的水上警察郭得友與師弟丁卯在酒肉和尚李大愣的慫恿下一同探查三岔河口沉屍案，經歷了魏家墳探鬼樓陰陽河仙指路惡狗村捉妖，最終抓住幕後真兇的故事

programme.title: 魔鬼天使
programme.desc: 愛情至上的小宣，為了愛願意犧牲一切，而她也和男友志傑濃情蜜意如膠似漆，但是這段美滿的良緣卻因為夢虹的介入，受到了衝擊富家千金夢虹性情孤僻，她和男友被頑固的父親拆散，男友更不幸死於車禍當心如死灰的夢虹第一眼見到志傑，她的生命再次燃起了火花，志傑竟與死去的男友如此相似

programme.title: 英雄訣41-42首
programme.desc: 英雄訣41-42首

programme.title: 巴頓將軍
programme.desc: 二戰中期，當德軍元帥沙漠之狐隆美爾橫掃北非之際，為了扭轉局勢，美方指派巴頓接任英美聯軍的美軍指揮官這位治軍嚴謹特立獨行的將軍，一舉將隆美爾趕出北非，造成德國極大的震撼；然而巴頓藐視命令為求勝仗不顧部下死活的行事風格，在日後的西西里戰役造成盟軍極大傷亡才獲得慘勝，隨即遭到解職然爾後戰事逆轉，盟軍統帥艾森豪只得再次啟用這位德軍剋星重返戰場，解救友軍直搗柏林

programme.title: 白髮魔女傳
programme.desc: 武當奇才卓一航幼年結識一神秘狼女成年後的卓一航為人正直，仗義行俠卻屢遭所指大師姐雖對其傾心，他卻毫不動心後因誤入魔教禁地為長髮少女所救而難忘其倩影而欲一統江湖的魔教姬無雙，被同屬魔教的練霓裳所制伏，卓一航在混戰中發覺練霓裳正是當年救他一命的長髮少女，兩情相悅互許終身但武當長老囑卓一航應以大局為重，要練霓裳離去，練霓裳因心傷導致烏髮瞬間全白，正邪終不兩立

programme.title: 633轟炸大隊
programme.desc: 二戰期間，挪威反抗軍領袖艾利克冒死劫機逃至英國，帶來德軍在挪威秘密研發飛彈準備對盟軍展開致命攻擊的情報英軍命令格蘭特指揮官的蚊式戰鬥轟炸機633中隊，執行摧毀德軍隱身在挪威險峻峽灣飛彈工廠的任務艾利克奉命返回挪威帶領反抗軍破壞保護工廠的防空陣地，卻不幸被蓋世太保所擄並遭嚴刑拷問；消息傳回英國，為避免任務曝光急命633中隊全員出動救援

programme.title: 大稻埕
programme.desc: 大學生佑熙及歷史系豬教授陰錯陽差穿越時空，回到了1920年代台灣最繁華的大稻埕兩人不僅意外捲入了日本皇太子蒞台蔣渭水抗爭等歷史上至關重要的大事件，更分別跟性格強悍獨力開了間裁縫店的奇女子阿純，以及風華絕代色藝雙全的首席藝旦阿蕊，展開了甜蜜纏綿的跨時代戀曲

programme.title: 蝙蝠俠1966
programme.desc: 高譚市四大惡徒：貓女企鵝人謎天大聖小丑，這次他們一起聯手結盟，駕著擁有洲際飛彈的企鵝核動力潛艇，劫持了一艘正駛往高譚市載有最新脫水科技儀器的遊艇這次，壞蛋們除了要除掉蝙蝠俠和羅賓的正義二人組外，最終目標是即將在高譚市召開的聯合國九大安理會員國會議，欲藉機控制全球！蝙蝠俠和羅賓該如何將四大惡徒繩之以法拯救世界呢？

programme.title: 庫德行動首
programme.desc: 完成大學學業後回到家鄉，錫昂親眼目睹村莊遭到焚燒和一系列的暴行，最終導致他加入了庫德族人的抵抗運動，並在與土耳其軍隊的衝突中受到嚴重傷害

programme.title: 女人要有錢
programme.desc: 知名女作家吳淡如，以她知性且深入人心的形象，攜手專業寶物鑑定團隊，帶領觀眾走進藝人名人貴婦及素人家中，鑑賞他們珍藏的寶物及收藏品節目將通過生動的賞寶過程，向觀眾傳授基礎的賞寶知識，讓大家在輕鬆愉快的氛圍中，學會如何鑑定家中的寶物究竟這些珍藏能否讓你一夜致富，還是讓你瞬間崩盤？敬請鎖定，一同探索古今寶物的奧秘！

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 無雙樓掌廚 四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館無雙樓他收下四名徒弟南花西紅東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團花花食界由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟無雙宴，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 全台首播心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.title: 只屬於我的你雙語版
programme.desc: 渣男律師劈腿富豪千金 李敏英逆襲成知名設計師恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福

programme.title: 整形過後--慾望與認同新
programme.desc: 台灣首部整形醫療影集整形過後，整的不只是臉，而是心！！華麗卻殘酷的醫美產業，揭開變美的創傷與代價技術頂尖卻內心破碎的整形外科醫師江浩宇，遇上正直倔強從公立醫院轉來的楊雅頌，被迫直視醫療倫理與八年前未解的傷痛兩人與診所執行長蘇菲，交織出情感與權力的拉扯一樁樁醫美案例浮上檯面，被控制的女星術後猝死的公關非法醫療與重建自我的病人，不斷拷問真正的治療是什麼這是一段關於修復放下與重生的故事

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋雙語版
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.desc: 母親宣布卒婚引發家庭風暴 父親失憶揭露大女兒身世秘密故事圍繞著一對老年夫婦和他們的三名成年子女展開母親突然宣佈要卒婚，因厭倦與脾氣火爆的父親同居，父親則因委屈一度想輕生，卻失敗導致失憶回到22歲，意外揭露大女兒並非親生的秘密大女兒恩珠發現丈夫是同性戀，內心崩潰，而二女兒恩熙則陷入了複雜的感情糾葛中，被劈腿後又成了上司的情人小兒子智宇無意中知曉了家族的深藏秘密像外人一樣的家人間產生誤會，不斷磨合理解的家庭劇

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 姜素拉化身訴訟女神 離婚怨偶再擦出火花所謂相愛容易，相處難，恩範荷拉已愛情長跑 10 年結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是行走的贍養費原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約面對最熟悉的陌生人前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 羅美蘭化身高年級實習生 道盡女性職場家庭壓力曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手如今成為上司的崔智媛在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 不像三兄弟完
programme.desc: 李浚赫化身金家小兒子 婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚不折不撓的品性宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業

programme.title: 陷入純情完
programme.desc: 浪漫速成鄭敬淏 愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人復仇心的驅使下，他成為Gold Partners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事

programme.title: 嫁到這世界邊端粵
programme.desc: 香港OL Judy一次到泰國旅遊，改寫了一生Judy說出七年前與Dass在翟道翟初次邂逅的故事，陳貝兒點出了不合理的情節，力證Judy那一刻已採取極主動攻勢！其後Judy以慶祝生日作藉口，特意飛往泰國，溶化了Dass的心兩人言語不通，是怎樣打破彼此隔膜，深入了解對方的內心？嫁到泰國，Judy與Dass一同發展其精品店，承受炎熱天氣及骯髒環境，Judy為摯愛甘願捱苦，令貝兒感覺到兩口子的幸福

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺手起刀落示範斬雞，斬得俐落還要砌得好睇；三姐則教路燉出滴雞精俊彥以紅酒入饌炮製紅酒燉雞除了西菜必備的洋蔥西芹甘筍，菜式還加入煎香意大利醃豬腩肉的香味期間鼎爺突然考俊彥對烹調的認知，幸俊彥經驗搭夠過關！煒哥帶來創新海南雞壽司，以椰香飯配上嫩滑雞肉，煒哥即席示範浸雞技巧她以斑蘭葉紅尖椒等炮製兩款醬汁，一啖一口的海南雞飯帶來視覺味覺新享受今集是法國菜式與南亞風味的角力！

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 今集以麵食為主題，鼎爺示範手搓銀針粉，三姐則傳授令紅薯粉口感QQ的技巧煒哥即席製作薄薄的麵皮裹着五香豆腐蝦皮粉絲韭菜餡料，煎得金黃香脆，幻化成特色北方美食韭菜盒子，配上清涼的韓式番茄仔同吃，開胃減膩！俊彥以全雞金華火腿製作雞濃湯配上手工麵，將煎香雞丸串懸在碗邊，既能保持香脆的口感，又令菜式賣相精緻獨特煒哥與俊彥都以手作麵為亮點，盡顯心思及耐性，誰的作品能令評判眼前一亮？

programme.title: 世紀工程機場三跑道系統粵
programme.desc: 香港國際機場二號客運大樓T2，是機場三跑道系統工程內其中一個最主要嘅設施，T2離港設施在五月啟用後，預計首12個月可以處理800萬人次旅客T2與T1相連，建築採用了羽翼屋頂設計，利用自然採光，營造出一個寬敞舒適的空間T2主力使用自助智能設施，一站式完成託運行李手續本系列同時介紹了機場三跑工程的種種突破，包括採用深層水泥拌合法填海，減少對海洋生態的影響機管局更成立改善海洋生態及漁業提升基金，支持機構進行研究和保育項目

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵

programme.title: 甜心先生粵

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 阿渡和阿驅拍片癮發作，並趁機向瑪蘿學習拍片秘訣，此時另一名RyuTuber紅企鵝講師出現，其魔性配樂和口號令人不禁咐和，紅企鵝加入一起授課，但內容卻越趨嚴格，後來更出現強人所難的無理要求

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 兒童節目Hands Up有醬汁家族成員和一眾主持，陪伴大家度過愉快時光Kids Notes邀請不同界別人士，跟小朋友分享有趣事物；透過勇闖小兵團遊戲，讓孩子們快樂遊玩；運動教練引領大家Workout 2gether，鍛練身體；還會透過Artspiration，引領孩子了解藝術世界；My Little Show開放表演舞台，小朋友到來盡情展示才藝！

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 山根希望自己的腸胃變得強壯，而每日跑步見此，小丸子與爺爺想幫助山根故事背景變成古代小丸子一家是忍者為了獲得正式的忍者裝備，小丸子接受爸爸提出的考驗，前往據說有妖怪出現的城堡尋找寶物

programme.title: 財經透視粵

programme.title: 2026香港小姐競選決賽直播粵
programme.desc: 2026香港小姐競選的主題是敢．至完美，馬國明蕭正楠曹永廉這三名演戲為主的小生，也敢於連同陸浩明鄭衍峰組成嶄新的司儀陣容，為十二位候選佳麗於決賽展現才藝服飾穿搭答問急才的考核協力，同時見證冠亞季軍，以及最上鏡小姐友誼小姐的誕生大會亦邀來歌星李幸倪曾比特張與辰梁漢文女團MYNT，還有港姐師姐郭柏妍陳楨怡謝淑怡出任表演嘉賓，聯同眾佳麗一起送上最精彩的舞台時刻

programme.desc: 皇牌大放送是鳳凰衛視中文台精心製作的週末黃金檔紀錄片節目, 題目緊隨國內外時事焦點, 以及社會歷史文化熱點節目具備強烈即時性, 將最熱門的社會或時政話題在最令人關注的時間點爆發式呈現

programme.title: 鳳凰午間專列
programme.desc: 鳳凰午間專列: 鳳凰中午的強檔新聞節目, 採取泛中華的報道態度, 關注中國內地的新聞, 也關注香港台灣以及國際的新聞, 視野更廣闊, 話語空間亦突顯其獨特之處節目簡潔實事求事快人一步, 將新聞帶給正在享用午餐的您, 讓您在休息時段毋須讀報而能輕鬆地接收全球最新出爐的新聞資訊

programme.title: 冷暖人生 第441集

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sisters wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: Promising martial artist Chao Chih Hao leaves home to compete in a prestigious tournament after training under a legendary master. However, when a corrupt rival school hires Japanese fighters to cripple him, Chao endures brutal training to master the deadly Iron Fist technique and return for a fierce, bone-crushing battle for justice and glory.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her familys objection, so Hongs maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Wei Chun is a cocky young man sentenced to jail for killing a man in a fight. One day, Wei Chun picks a fight with a seemingly defenseless old man who completely thrashes him! The old man turns out to be the master of monkey style kung fu and as they become friends, he gives Wei Chun half of a medallion that would direct him to hidden secrets.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of Robin Hood meets The Sting. Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying whos done over 400 films as Tricky Ching, its the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. Its a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because peoples lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qis guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zangs journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sisters death, but is shocked to discover that her fianc, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jins mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws lot in the final years of Hong Kongs greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu Mok Siu-chung is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit Wei Chiu-hua is killing swordsmen, hes in for more than he bargains for... Its an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword arent nearly enough!

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wens brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wens home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The films action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jins daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: A seasoned burglar The Lizard sets himself up against a corrupt police chief and announced that he will steal a diamond from a rich mans party. His real identity, which is discovered by the corrupt police chiefs granddaughter, is actually a young policeman who is doing it all for justice.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her fathers towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her fathers debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kongs Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee aka. Li Hsiu-hsien as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Jailed for accidental manslaughter, martial arts master Har Hao Mo discovers a killer targeting kung fu masters across Hong Kong. Determined to stop the murders, he helps police track down Fung Yu Sau, a ruthless fighter obsessed with proving his supremacy. As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tais father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror her father is peeping at night and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the directors previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killers claims of an evil spell, then it doesnt let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his familys massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Hail the Judge
programme.desc: A low level magistrate is run out of town for defending a beautiful murder suspect. Through a series of comedic events he ascends to the top rank returns looking for revenge.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Societys conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its Cop Shop Babes as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughters company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Feis possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Casino Tycoon. 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

Each 30-minute TV edition is hosted by a long-term expatriate in China who has a unique understanding of the countrys culture. He or she will introduce viewers to people who are dedicating their lives to its protection, inheritance, innovation, development and promotion.

programme.title: DJ Catnip Gets His Groove Back
programme.desc: Gabby brings DJ Catnip a microphone for him to use in the big music show, but he has some terrible news: he lost his groove! Determined to help him get his groove back, Gabby and Pandy take him on a musical search through the dollhouse. As they go, Gabby uses the microphone to record sounds from the Gabby Cats everyday activities that culminate into a new song that gets DJ his groove back just in time for the show! In our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, Gabby sings a song!

programme.title: Kitty Fairy Gets Sick
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a recipe for dandelion soup and a soup bowl, she discovers Kitty Fairy is sick! Gabby and Pandy make her some delicious dandelion soup and while she rests, they take care of her Garden. With the help of all the Gabby Cats, they water the Singing Flowers, help the Rainbow Kitty Bushes regain their color, and sing some fussy Itty Bitty Blossoms a lullaby. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Kitty Fairy sings a song!

programme.title: A Tale of Two Kitties
programme.desc: Alex is mistaken for a Maine Coon and takes over that cats life in the penthouse. At first, VERY comfortable with his shmancy new life, Alex grows to miss his old life and learns that its lonely at the top.

programme.title: Fire Marshal Melman
programme.desc: On Junior Marshals Day at the fire station, Melman gets stuck in a firetruck on its way to a real emergency. With Alexs help, Melman must overcome his fear of heights to help save a stuck cat, and learn that even heroes get scared sometimes.

programme.title: Somewhere Over the Rainbow
programme.desc: Kelp is swept by an ocean current to the shore of Unicorn Land where he sees a majestic creature on a cliff that looks just like him, but not like his Narwhal family under the sea. Kelp tells his family hes a unicorn. Kelp returns to Unicorn Land where he meets Pixie and Juniper, who show him around and introduce him to unicorn spark and magic.

programme.title: Tacos Rainy Day
programme.desc: When Kelp is introduced to crunchy tacos in Unicorn Land, he must use his bubble sparks to bring them back to his family underwater. Kelps unicorn friends are going to teach him Swishbee on land. But it rains and the game is called off until Kelp shows them that playing in the water can be even more fun.

programme.title: Dog the Right Thing
programme.desc: In preparation for the big race to determine the next Race Cadets, Sam Whippet challenges the Not Yet Cadets to build their own cars. The catch? The car parts are scattered throughout Pawston. The Not Yet Cadets compete in the final race to see which team will join the Race Cadets.

programme.title: All Paws on Deck Bonestand and Deliver
programme.desc: Tag wants to do something special for her Mom and Paws anniversary, so she recreates the boat cruise where her parents first met. Tag discovers that nothing is planned for Pawstons 100th birthday, so she decides the town needs to rebuild the old Bonestand for a big Pawston concert.

programme.title: Rodney J. Dinkle, Babysitter Lights Out
programme.desc: When accident-prone Rodney gets hired to babysit a mischievous toddler, TZG secretly watches over their safety. When theres a power outage in Harmony Harbor, TZG secretly helps the townsfolk beat the blackout.

programme.title: Double Booked Gym Enemy Cricket
programme.desc: When both Sam and Gabriel pre-order the new Commander Kale comic but the supplier only sends one copy, TZG secretly ferries the comic book back and forth between readers. When Fawna teaches a silent yoga class, TZG secretly find and remove a loud chirping cricket from the Community Center.

programme.title: Boo to You
programme.desc: Burple gets spooked by the legend of a ghost called the Phantom Fang. But when he senses the story is real, he cant get his friends to believe him.

programme.title: Where Theres Smoke
programme.desc: After Magnus accuses Cutter of setting fires near the village that could hurt the sheep, the Riders have to put them out and find the real culprit.

programme.title: Fluffy Flufferton
programme.desc: Feline popstar sensation Fluffy Flufferton is performing a concert at the Dollhouse Hotel, and Gabby unboxes tickets to see her! Gabby meets Fluffy and discovers that shes afraid to try new things because she doesnt want to make mistakeswhy mess with perfection? But with the help of the Gabby Cats, Fluffy learns how to fail fantastically and be the most fluff-tastic version of herself. For our Cat of the Day segment, DJ Catnip sings a song about the Dollhouse Hotel.

programme.title: Cakeys Cupcake Cousins
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a tin full of Cakey-like cupcake kitties, she realizes... Cakeys Cousins are coming to visit! Cakey welcomes his Cousins to the dollhouse and leads them through a fun-filled itinerary of activities, but quickly realizes his cousins have an agenda of their own. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Pillow Cat sings a song!

programme.title: Rude-A-Snakening Afteryard
programme.desc: After being stuck inside a snake, the Mighty Ones escape, but the yard that was their home has changed and is now a much more hostile environment. The newly renovated yard is inhospitable, but the Mighty Ones find a paradise on the refreshment table at a garden party... until the guests arrive.

programme.title: Too Many Bens! Dance of the Machines
programme.desc: A lack of predators in the new yard has led to an infestation of Bens, and they are looking for playmates. The new humans that live in the house notices theres dirt in their yard i.e. our heroes so they release a cleaning robot which becomes a deadly menace.

programme.title: King Pickles
programme.desc: When Kid Pickles is feeling down on his birthday, Puss and Artephius create a magical scroll that names Kid Pickles as heir to the San Lorenzo throne.

programme.title: Pirate Booty
programme.desc: After pirates invade San Lorenzo searching for mystical treasure, Puss leads them on the hunt, hoping his share will defend against the Bloodwolf

programme.title: Lucky And The New Governor
programme.desc: The girls plans to attend the Governors Ball are waylaid when they save a pregnant horse.

programme.title: Lucky And The Risky Rescue
programme.desc: When a Tuckapaw boy is unfairly arrested, Lucky and her friends plan to break him out of jail.

programme.title: The Frontier Fillies Summer Outdoor Jubilee
programme.desc: Luckys competitive side comes out at the Frontier Fillies Summer Outdoor Jubilee when the PALs meet the BUDs -- a group of talented young rivals.

programme.title: The Frontier Fillies Great Legacy Race
programme.desc: The PALs are determined to place first in a race for the coveted Frontier Fillies Legacy Pin. But the BUDs are willing to do anything to win.

programme.title: In Too Deep
programme.desc: Tom and the riders borrow the bathysphere to rescue a dragon from the depths of the Giant Realm Sea.

programme.title: Hobs and Saw
programme.desc: When Phil threatens to shut down DAngelos new dragon hospital and ban dragons from ICARIS, DAngelo and a little Hobgobbler have to change his mind.

programme.title: Hearts of Heroes
programme.desc: While Tom struggles with admitting his feelings for Jun, the pair find themselves trapped inside a giant tree with an anxious colony of Woodchipper dragons.

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Boss and family go on Spring Break to visit his grandparents in the big city of Chicago. Boss uses the trip to test his business mettle, by getting in a promotion war at a real big adult company. And when a department store refuses to let Gigi and Tim return an item, they wind up unionizing the entire sales force.

programme.title: Baby Boss
programme.desc: Mom and Dad are panicking after Gigi noticed Boss isnt growing, so Boss puts himself under, taking a special formula that will turn him int a regular baby long enough to pass a Doctors checkup. However, with Boss gone, all the villains from this season see it as the perfect time to strike Baby Corp, leaving Staci to hold the floodgates.

programme.title: Boom Baby
programme.desc: Looking to trim costs, Boss unknowingly fires Boom Baby, a super-undercover Baby Corp worker who displays to parents how unsafe things are by pratfalling on them and crying for attention. Convinced hes the victim of a conspiracy, Boom leaves a wake of parent worry in his path, forcing Boss to stop him.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Abandoned Artifact of the Absentee Aliens
programme.desc: After George and Harold learn the truth about their mission, Dupe Licitous enlists the entire crew in a quest to repair a rogue satellite.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Hazardous Hysteria of the Hangry Hypnosinger
programme.desc: Everybody on the spaceship has been cryogenically frozen for three months everyone, that is, except Krupp, whos wide awake and happily in charge.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Disturbing Dilemma of the Dysfunctional Doppelgangers
programme.desc: The crew meets their blue-hued doppelgngers when they crash-land on an alien planet where kids call all the shots.

programme.title: Total Nightmare
programme.desc: When Hookfang is drawn to a female Monstrous Nightmare, Snotlout tries to break them up before he loses his friend forever.

programme.title: Team Astrid
programme.desc: After Dagur attacks Berk, Astrid trauns a crew of back-up Dragon riders to battle back, although no one anticipates how soon the strike will come.

programme.title: Night Of The Hunters Pt 1
programme.desc: When Stormfly is captured by a new enemy, Ryker Grimborn, and the Dragon Hunters, Hiccup, Toothless and the team must rescue her before its too late

programme.title: Escape from L.A.
programme.desc: Tony and his crew have been working as spy racers in LA for a while now and are itching to go international. Whey they discover a mysterious man with a strange tattoo of a formula in a smuggling ring bust, Ms. Nowhere finally agrees to let them go to Rio to investigate the tattoo and the whereabouts of one of her agents who has gone dark - Layla Gray.

programme.title: That Sinking Feeling
programme.desc: Ms. Nowhere drops the kids off in Brazil and leaves to go on her own important mission, but things immediately go south for Tony and his crew. When the hauler and gear gets caught in quicksand, Tony needs to learn that a good leader knows when to accept help.

programme.title: Bem-Vindo ao Rio
programme.desc: After losing their mission materials in quicksand, Tony decides to channel Dom and Blend in to get intel from the people of Rio. Unfortunately its more difficult than he expected, and Tony and his crew are picked up by a group of favela gangsters in a neighborhood that worships a mysterious young female martyr. The crew is relieved to find that Layla is in charge of the gangsters - until she orders the gangsters to dispose of them!

programme.title: The Beginning of the End
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponentsher mom. And somehow, Po finds himself in a chess tournament against the Queen of Englan

programme.title: Zagreb Grand Prix
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best Judo from the Zagreb Grand Prix, where some of the young Judo fans get the opportunity to train with former Olympic champion Mark Huizinga and triple world champion Illias Iliadis. Plus we watch as Judos biggest star Teddy Riner competes in the 100 kg division.

programme.title: Animals Decoded Season 1
programme.desc: Join researchers as they study how animals communicate. Find out how wolves use their body language to unite the pack and maintain a sophisticated social structure, and see the astounding number of gestures chimps use to communicate.

programme.title: Animals Decoded Season 1
programme.desc: Tune into the natural world and explore frequencies beyond human hearing, like the gentle hum of giraffes in the evening, or creatures who use song to claim territory on a seemingly silent coral reef.

programme.title: Animals Decoded Season 1
programme.desc: Could undiscovered animal languages save some of our most endangered species? From subtle scents to colors that are invisible to the human eye, uncover the hidden ways creatures communicate, which scientists are only starting to understand.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons Season 2
programme.desc: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffes demise becomes a source of life for the regions vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons Season 2
programme.desc: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the regions species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the citys shrinking wetlands.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons Season 2
programme.desc: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons Season 2
programme.desc: Surviving the African savanna requires guile and teamwork for species who live in packs. Follow a day in the life of African wild dogs and dwarf mongooses to see how they rely on their tight-knit families to overcome the challenging landscape.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons Season 2
programme.desc: A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial. From loose associations to tight-knit partnerships, everything has a place in natures great scheme. Complex interactions between species are not even limited to animals, and some of the best examples occur in the lush mountain forests of Africa.

programme.title: Woodpeckers: The Hole Story
programme.desc: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the worlds 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are natures best lumberjacks explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills and get a look inside their secret nests.

programme.title: Airborne Season 1
programme.desc: Watch beginners make their first leap into the air, like an Andean condor who must attend flight school before spreading its wings. Meet oddballs who soar without feathers and marvel at a peregrine falcons speed as it dives to catch its prey.

programme.title: Airborne Season 1
programme.desc: Go hunting with flyers who excel at making mid-air catches. Watch the metamorphosis of the acrobatic emperor dragonfly, admire the barn owls stealthy approach to prey, and catch a wandering salamanders death-defying leap into the abyss.

programme.title: Airborne Season 1
programme.desc: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Take flight with a bee crafting a custom love potion, watch a draco lizard soar to fend off rivals, and witness the graceful pas de deux that bonds a pair of Japanese cranes for life.

programme.title: Airborne Season 1
programme.desc: Plot a course for adventure as animals go on remarkable journeys through the skies. Navigate a wooden labyrinth with a speedy goshawk, join a sandgrouses trek to a distant watering hole, and see a murmuration of starlings mesmerize their nemesis.

programme.title: 13 Hours to Survive Season 1
programme.desc: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

programme.title: 13 Hours to Survive Season 1
programme.desc: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

programme.title: Psycho
programme.desc: When Dahini, a radio jockey, is kidnapped by a psychopath, her lover, Gautham, fails to save her due to his blindness. Later, he sets out to rescue her in time with a former police officers help.

programme.desc: 中央电视台唯一的涉台时事新闻评论栏目节目宗旨是跟踪海峡热点，反映两岸民意，节目分为两个版块：第一个是热点扫描，主要报道当日的近期台湾岛内的热点新闻；第二个是热点透视，当日或近期涉台热点深度报道及两岸专家对此事的评论，并对两岸各个层面的交流交往进行跟踪报道

programme.title: 中国新闻China News

programme.title: 今日关注Focus Today
programme.desc: 今日关注紧密跟踪国内外重大新闻事件新闻话题，邀请国内外一流的专家和高级官员，梳理新闻来龙去脉，分析新闻背后的新闻，评论新闻事件的影响和发展趋势

programme.title: 走遍中国Around China
programme.desc: 主要以中国的某一城市（或地域或主题）为选题范围，选取其最具的历史传承风土人情杰出人物自然风光和发展变化以连续一周每天30分钟播出的大容量，向世界全景式地展现新世纪的中国城市（或地域）形象

programme.title: 新闻联播Network News
programme.desc: 新闻联播是中国中央电视台于1978年1月1日创办的综合性新闻节目该栏目由中央电视台牵头主办全国各省级电视台合办旨在囊括国内外要闻，宣传党和政府的路线方针政策，反映群众呼声，提供各种重要信息它的收视率雄居中央电视台各档节目的首位，是国内外观众群最庞大影响最广泛的电视新闻栏目

programme.title: 绝命法官Justice Is Mine
programme.desc: 在二十世纪九十年代初的濠港，法官秦誉与高级督察唐萱二人曾联手将社团头目韩奎龙成功定罪然而秦誉之子意外撞伤韩家长子后，他陷入法理与亲情的两难抉择，最终竟选择伪造证据，为掩盖真相不惜伪造证据嫁祸他人，从法律的守护者坠落为规则的挑战者，将罪责嫁祸给一名偷车少年随着唐萱深入追查这起案件，官商勾结的暗流警界内部的腐败，以及多桩陈年旧案的隐秘关联也逐渐浮出水面，勾勒出一幅复杂的年代罪案图景Qin Yu, who used to be an upright judge, covered up the truth that his son caused an accident and injured the son of a gang leader in a traffic collision. To avenge his son, the gang leader stirred up a storm of bloodshed.

programme.title: Woodpeckers: The Hole Story
programme.desc: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the worlds 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are natures best lumberjacks explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills and get a look inside their secret nests.

programme.title: Airborne Season 1
programme.desc: Watch beginners make their first leap into the air, like an Andean condor who must attend flight school before spreading its wings. Meet oddballs who soar without feathers and marvel at a peregrine falcons speed as it dives to catch its prey.

programme.title: Airborne Season 1
programme.desc: Go hunting with flyers who excel at making mid-air catches. Watch the metamorphosis of the acrobatic emperor dragonfly, admire the barn owls stealthy approach to prey, and catch a wandering salamanders death-defying leap into the abyss.

programme.title: Airborne Season 1
programme.desc: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Take flight with a bee crafting a custom love potion, watch a draco lizard soar to fend off rivals, and witness the graceful pas de deux that bonds a pair of Japanese cranes for life.

programme.title: Airborne Season 1
programme.desc: Plot a course for adventure as animals go on remarkable journeys through the skies. Navigate a wooden labyrinth with a speedy goshawk, join a sandgrouses trek to a distant watering hole, and see a murmuration of starlings mesmerize their nemesis.

programme.title: 13 Hours to Survive Season 1
programme.desc: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

programme.title: 13 Hours to Survive Season 1
programme.desc: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

programme.title: Strange Creatures Season 2
programme.desc: Hiding in plain sight helps many insect, fish, and amphibian species survive. Learn the ins and outs of an array of animal invisibility techniques, such as warning and disruptive colouration, mimicry, and active camouflage.

programme.title: Ningaloo: Australias Ocean Wonder Season 1
programme.desc: Learn how Ningaloos conservation miracle could inspire humans to pull the planet back from the brink of climatic destruction. Visit an abandoned whaling station and other ruins that show we have the tools, if only we can find the will to change.

programme.title: Turtle Beach
programme.desc: Locals call it the arribada, or arrival. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

programme.title: Planet Weird Season 1
programme.desc: Look at the supercharged abilities that give some animals an edge in life. Discover fireflies flirty flashes, the tarsiers incredible night vision, the mantis shrimps knockout punch, and the saltwater crocs prey-detecting pressure sensors.

programme.title: Animals Like Us Season 1
programme.desc: Discover why it takes a village to raise lion cubs in Kenya and sniff out the mating strategy of fragrant lemurs in Madagascar. Cut a rug at a honeybee dance party, then listen up as a forked-tailed drongo tricks other birds out of their dinner.

Anggara dan Aini merupakan pasangan suami isteri yang hidup bahagia. programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP1
programme.desc: Pengantara Saiful Azmi Jamsari berkongsi pengalaman semasa merakamkan beberapa episod Detik 12 Malam sebelum ini. Antaranya Episod 1 Musim 1 bertajuk Kisah Penggali Kubur. Beliau terlihat asap berkepul-kelul semasa menggali kubur semasa rakaman. Episod 2 Musim 2, Bertajuk Pemandu Kenderaan Jenazah. Pengantara memandu sendiri van tersebut dan dilihat kain meliput jenazah diterbalikkan. Episod 12 Musim1, Petugas Bilik Mayat. Pengantara berkongsi pengalaman apabila melihat kemunculan lembaga. Episod 9 Musim 2, bertajuk Muzium Perang. Pengantara ternampak patung dalam muzium perang tibatiba- tiba seakan-akan kepalanya bergerak. Episod 3 Musim 1, bertajuk Renjer Hutan. Beliau bertugas sebagai renjer hutan, diganggu oleh saka masyarakat orang asli. Pengantara melihat sendiri makhluk halus melalui kawasan tersebut

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP1
programme.desc: Imbas kembali 12 tahun lalu di sebuah Kg Kuala Pari Hilir. Tiga kanak-kanak bersahabat iaitu Yeh Kumbang, Gani Gagap dan Li Kelubi perlu melintasi rumah Wan Peah selepas mengaji Quran. Wan Peah dikatakan seorang yang misteri, tinggal sendirian, mengamal ilmu hitam dan sering mengganggu kanak-kanak ini. Tok Hashim sebagai ketua kampung mempunyai seorang anak lelaki bernama Faan yang selalu bermain dengan Yeh, Gani dan Li. Suatu hari semasa bermain menyorok berhampiran dengan rumah Wan Peah, Faan dia telah dibawa lari oleh Wan Peah masuk ke rumahnya.

programme.title: Sweetpea EP6

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP1
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Lisa dari sebuah NGO masuk ke kampung untuk membantu Bayu yang menjadi mangsa rogol. Insiden tersebut mengingatkan Lisa kejadian yang sama pernah berlaku kepadanya 7 tahun lalu di rogol oleh sekumpulan lelaki bertopeng. Bayu kemudiannya meninggal dunia. Mbah Ngai dibantu oleh Afifa membantu Siti anak Pak Samad yang sedang kemurungan. Afifa mengambil kesempatan, kononnya Siti terkena ilmu hitam. Pak Samad membayar sejumlah wang upahan kepada Afifa bagi membalas dendam perbuatan bomoh tersebut. Mbah Ngai menjaga Sarah anak kepada Afifa yang mengalami tekanan. Nasrun bersama kumpulannya membuat onak di kampong tersebut, mereka yang menculik Bayu dan membunuhnya. Kumpulan ini diketuai oleh Pak Samad. Manakala Afifa menggunakan ilmu hitam ke atas Mak Leha, emak kepada Bayu. Manakala Lisa bersama Syamil seorang bekas Inspektor meneruskan siasatan mereka bagi menangkap perogol Bayu.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP2
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Lisa bersama Syamil balik ke kampong untuk membantu Mak Leha menyiasat kejadian anaknya Bayu yang mati selepas dirogol. Mereka singgah di rumah Mbah Hira untuk berjumpa dengan Afifa dan Sarah. Syamil terpaksa meninggalkan mereka selepas di marahi oleh Afifa. Lisa berkongsi maklumat tentang kejadian rogol yang menimpa dirinya, Afifa, Sarah dan Bayu. Nasrun di ugut oleh Azhar, Caryl dan Bakri kerana cuba lari dari kumpulan mereka. Kumpulan perogol membuar perancangan untuk merogol cucu Pak Samad. Mbah Hari marahkan Afifa kerana menggunakan ilmu hitam ke atas Mak Leha, dia berusaha mengubati kaki Mak Leha. Sebaliknya, Afifa meminta sejumpalh wang dari Mak Leha kerana mereka mengubati kaki Mak Leha yang telah menjadi busuk.

programme.title: Hysteria! EP8
programme.desc: Kebenaran akhirnya terbongkar dalam kemuncak yang penuh kejutan dan akibat besar kepada semua.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP4
programme.desc: Kumpulan Hunter berjaya menangkap Siti semula, lalu merogolnya. Syamil menunjukkan gambar Nasrun kepadanya Lisa, dia memberitahu Afifa yang dia syak Nasrun dan rakan-rakannya adalah perogol mereka 7 tahun lalu. Afifa menggunakan ilmu hitamnya ke atas Nasrun, namun Mbah Ngai merampas peralatan tersebut. Imbas kembali 7 tahun lalu, Afifa, Sara dan Lisa diserang Kumpulan Hunter yang bertopeng, mereka menculik dan merogol mereka. Lisa keluar bersama Afifa ke rumah kosong lokasi mereka pernah di rogol. Tiba-tiba mereka ternampak Siti terbaring keseorangan. Pada tangan Siti terdapat segumpal rambut perogolnya. Mereka membawa Siti balik untuk berjumpa dengan Pak Samad yang kebetulan baru sampai. Lisa ternampak seutas jam di bilik Siti, kebetulan jam yang sama pernah di terima oleh Lisa satu masa lalu. Manakala Afifa menggunakan sihir ke atas pemilik rambut yang diambil dari tangan Siti. Bakri tiba-tiba muntah darah semasa meraikan kejayaan mereka bersama Caryl dan Azhar

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP15
programme.desc: Alia dan Susan tertangkap. Adam sempat meyelamatkan mereka yang hampir dibunuh Dr Zahir. Zacky turut terselamat manakala Dr Zahir ditahan polis. Ritz yang dalam tahanan lelaki bertopeng dipaksa memanggil Alia datang kelokasi mereka. Lelaki bertopeng memanggil Adam datang kelokasi yang sama. Zacky tiba dilokasi bersama Alia. Berlaku pertarungan antara Zacky dan lelaki bertopeng. Adam menembak kaki lelaki bertopeng untuk menyelamatkan Zacky. Dalam masa yang sama Alia dan Kai pergi menyelamatkan Ritz. Mereka semua terkejut apabila mendapati lelaki bertopeng itu sebenarnya Rafeeq yang juga adik kembar Adam. Mereka berdua bersaing dalam misi membalas dendam terhadap Tan Seri Jalaludin yang telah merampas harta dan membunuh ibu bapa mereka. Adam menembak Rafeeq sebelum menembak Tan Seri Jalaludin. Selepas kejadian Adam meminta Zacky menyerahkanya kepada pihak berkuasa

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya Diana Danielle membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya Remy Ishak kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP1
programme.desc: Aafiyah dan Rizq anak kepada pasangan Adelia dan Rafeeq. Aafiyah dimasukkan ke hospital, semasa abangnya menzirahi Aafiyah doktor mengesahkan gadis tersebut mengalami trauma dan lupa ingatan. Sebulan sebelum kejadian, Aafiyah menyambut harijadinya di sebuah hotel tempat ibunya bekerja. Disebabkan kesibukan bekerja, kedua-duanya meninggalkan Aafiyah keseorangan. Aafiyah ternampak seorang bertopeng membunuh seorang wanita, dia yang ketakutan cuba melarikan diri tetapi berjaya ditangkap oleh pembunuh tersebut. Aafiyah berjanji tidak akan membuka rahsia tersebut kepada sesiapa. Aafiyah bersama ibunya berjaya menyelamatkan berkereta keluar dari hotel. Namun pembunuh tersebut berjaya menahan mereka dan membunuh ibunya

programme.title: Nasi Tangas
programme.desc: Hairi dan Fatin adalah seorang kawan rapat. Mereka berdua bersama-sama membangunkan sebuah kafe yang dibuka bersama-sama. Hubungan mereka adalah seperti sepasang kekasih, tetapi Hairi dan Fatin tidak pernah lebih daripada seorang rakan. Mira juga rakan yang baik untuk Fatin. Mira mengakui bahawa dia jatuh cinta dengan Hairi.

programme.title: Ia Wujud
programme.desc: Sekumpulan remaja menceroboh masuk ke sebuah taman tema yang telah lama ditinggalkan. Berlatarbelakangkan zaman sebelum tersebarnya kisah-kisah seram dari kes Highland Tower, kumpulan ini percaya bahawa hantu tidak wujud. Lalu mereka mencabar satu sama lain untuk bermain permainan roh duit syiling di dalam taman tema terbiar itu.

programme.title: Interchange
programme.desc: Dihantui oleh penglihatan yang suram, jurugambar forensik Adam berundur dari dunia, tinggal di rumah dan mengambil gambar jirannya sehingga dia diseret ke dalam penyiasatan lain oleh kawan baiknya, Detektif Man, yang meminta bantuannya untuk menyelesaikan siri pembunuhan ritual yang mengerikan. Pada masa yang sama, hobi Adam yang kelihatan tidak berbahaya tidak lama kemudian menjadi lebih gelap apabila dia mengintip Iva, seorang wanita muda dari Borneo. Terpesona olehnya, dia tidak lama lagi terjerat dalam rangkaian misteri dan pembunuhannya. Ketika Adam diseret lebih jauh ke dalam dunia puak Iva dan Man menyelidiki penyiasatannya dengan lebih mendalam, mereka menemui mistik bawah tanah bomoh dan makhluk ghaib di bandar itu.

programme.title: The Professionals
programme.desc: Dikhianati oleh rakan niaganya, Reza, Abi dipenjarakan. Keluar dari penjara, dia merekrut mangsa Reza, dan merancang untuk membalas dendam.

programme.title: Midnight Show
programme.desc: Naya, Juna, Sarah dan seluruh pengunjung bioskop terlibat dalam misteri pembunuhan di sebuah bioskop tua pada tayangan tengah malam midnight. Pembunuhan terjadi saat bioskop sedang memutarkan film kontroversial tentang seorang anak umur 12 tahun yang membunuh dan memutilasi seluruh keluarganya.

programme.title: Saranjana Kota Ghaib
programme.desc: Apabila Sitha, penyanyi utama kumpulan terkenal hilang, kumpulan itu meneruskan pencarian, mengetahui bahawa Sitha berada di Saranjana, sebuah bandar ghaib, dan untuk membawanya kembali, mereka mesti mencari portal melalui pengembaraan peristiwa mistik.

programme.title: Dabbe Bir Cin Vakasi
programme.desc: Rumah sebuah keluarga di Turki dirasuk roh jahat yang ingin membunuh manusia.

programme.title: Abang Long Fadil 2
programme.desc: Kisah tentang Fadil yang terjerumus ke dalam dunia mafia yang diketuai oleh Taji Samprit dan anaknya, Wak Doyok. Satu insiden menyebabkan Inspektor Wahab dan Inspektor Shuib mengesyaki Fadil sebagai Tiger, seorang pembunuh upahan profesional.

programme.title: Hantu Baru
programme.desc: Sasa mati dalam kemalangan tanpa menyedari kematiannya. Dua roh membantunya memahami keadaan dan menyelamatkan adik-beradiknya supaya dia dapat pergi dengan tenang.

programme.title: J Revolusi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jay Zulkarnain Haji Zul Ariffin, ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK yang digeruni penjenayah. Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian Nur Fazura, ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra Farid Kamil, yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie Izara Aishah dan Jiman Iedil Putra, Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.

programme.title: The Lift
programme.desc: Selepas sahabat baiknya hilang, seorang gadis kolej yang menghidap klaustrofobia mula menyiasat lif misteri tempat rakannya kali terakhir dilihat lif yang mungkin merupakan pintu ke dunia gelap yang menakutkan.

programme.desc: Memaparkan Lisa marahkan Syamil yang datang ke rumah Mbah Nira untuk berjumpanya. Syamil syak kumpulan lelaki yang meminta pertolongannya adalah perogol. programme.desc: Ameera yang baru berpindah dari Sabah ke Kuala Lumpur bersekolah di kolej swasta, dan dipilih sebagai ketua kelas. programme.title: Suara Kekasih
programme.desc: Percintaan yang ditentang keluarga kerana perbezaan darjat membuatkan Ayu dan Taufiq terpaksa membawa haluan berbeza. Ayu, penyanyi di kelab malam jatuh cinta dengan Taufiq, pengurus syarikat insuran yang berasal dari keluarga kaya. Ditentang oleh ibu Taufiq, mereka merasakan restu keluarga amat penting dan terpaksa membuat keputusan penting untuk masa depan mereka.

programme.title: Si Jantung Hati
programme.desc: Dua adik beradik, Do dan Re, keluar menggembara untuk mencari harta pusaka kepunyaan ayah mereka yang telah lama disembunyikan. Sebelum itu, mereka perlu mencari sahabat lama ayah mereka yang mempunyai petunjuk lokasi harta itu. Tetapi sesuatu terjadi apabila musuh lama muncul kembali untuk mengambil harta pusaka itu kerana yakin bahawa itu miliknya yang telah dicuri ayah mereka bertahun-tahun dahulu.

programme.title: Manis Manis Sayang
programme.desc: Terkesan dengan tingkah laku Bahadom terhadapnya di khalayak ramai, Jalil membuat keputusan untuk berhenti bekerja. Namun Bahadom mempunyai rancangan lain apabila Datuk menyuruhnya untuk mencari seorang pegawai untuk dihantar ke luar negara. Kerana bencikan Jalil dan juga ingin memisahkannya dari Rosnah, Bahadom mahu menghantar Jalil ke luar negara.

programme.title: Antara Dua Hati
programme.desc: Datin Sharifah ialah seorang balu yang mempunyai dua orang anak remaja, Shah dan Ina. Shah mempunyai seorang teman wanita berbangsa Cina yang bernama Linda dan Ina pula bercinta dengan Johari. Dalam satu kemalangan, Datin Sharifah telah berkenalan dengan Jefri, seorang penyanyi kelab malam. Hubungan mereka kemudiannya menjadi semakin intim. Dalam masa yang sama, Ina pula jatuh cinta dengan Jefri.

Ketika dia terus berusaha mempertahankan perkahwinannya, ancaman baharu muncul. Ayu, yang masih taksub dengan Niko, semakin mengikatnya dalam perangkap dengan menggunakan anak mereka yang belum lahir sebagai umpan. Pada masa yang sama, naluri Starla merasakan ada sesuatu yang tidak kena, dan dia mula diburu oleh bayang-bayang serta rahsia gelap. Dengan keluarganya di ambang bahaya dan emosinya semakin tertekan, adakah Starla mampu melindungi orang-orang tersayang? Atau adakah pengkhianatan Niko akan mendorongnya melangkaui batas yang tidak boleh kembali?

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing Sammy has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan Priscilla Wong, causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai KK Cheung, Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam. Gold digger Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Cantopop At 50
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. Cantopop At 50 invites original singers or accomplished vocalists to reinterpret these once-popular classics that transcend generations, delivering high-quality musical enjoyment to music lovers. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestantsHo Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-szeset aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various outdoor experts on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong wild women with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: News Magazine 2026
programme.desc: News Perspective is a weekly program featuring in-depth coverage of notable news stories from Hong Kong and around the world. It focuses on social issues that matter most to Hong Kong residents and invites people from various sectors, scholars, and experts to discuss and analyze the underlying causes and developments.

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the citys structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of small spaces.

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to pass the level can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT100,000. The celebrity version offers viewers a chance to win prizes and gifts by interacting with the contestants in the live stream and sending emojis to cheer them on.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Another Era
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG Kwok Chun On saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAMs Wu Fung business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG Pat Poon. Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONGs son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU Chow Lai Ki, Niki, with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT Frankie Lam, faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANGs wife CHEUNG MING-HEI Tavia Yeung, CHUNG-YAMs grandson FONG CHAK-YU Benjamin Yuen and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI Chau Pak Ho also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.
